construct: The urachus derives from the intraembryonic allantoic connection between the developing bladder and umbilicus and normally obliterates. Complete persistence creates a patent tract that can drain urine from the umbilicus.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Urine-like umbilical drainage that increases with voiding plus a continuous bladder-dome-to-umbilicus tract is a completely patent urachus.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: An umbilical-urachal sinus can drain at the umbilicus, but it is blind-ending and does not communicate with the bladder, so drainage would not track urination through a continuous tract.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The ultrasound anatomy and voiding-related urine drainage distinguish a patent urachus from all partial urachal remnants and omphalomesenteric fistula.
